title: US judge dismisses Musk's fraud claims in OpenAI case at his request, plans to proceed to trial
title_zh: 美国法官应要求驳回马斯克在 OpenAI 案件中的欺诈指控，计划继续审理
summary: A U.S. judge on Friday dismissed Elon Musk's fraud claims in ‌his lawsuit accusing OpenAI and co-founder ‌Sam Altman of betraying OpenAI's original mission, but plans ​to proceed to trial on Musk's breach of charitable trust and unjust enrichment claims.
summary_zh: 周五，一名美国法官驳回了埃隆·马斯克在诉讼中的欺诈指控，指控 OpenAI 及其联合创始人萨姆·奥尔特曼背叛了 OpenAI 最初的使命，但计划继续对马斯克违反慈善信托和不当得利指控进行审判。

title: Elon Musk vs. Sam Altman, Mag 7 earnings, Fed meeting: What to Watch

title: VAST Data CEO discusses AI startup's new $30B valuation
title_zh: VAST Data首席执行官讨论AI初创公司新的30B美元估值
summary: Private AI infrastructure company VAST Data has powered ahead to a new valuation of $30 billion after raising over $1 billion in its latest Series B funding round.
summary_zh: 私营人工智能基础设施公司 VAST Data 在最新一轮 B 轮融资中筹集了超过 10 亿美元资金后，估值已升至 300 亿美元。

title: Thanks to high gas prices, interest in EVs is soaring
title_zh: 由于高油价，人们对电动汽车的兴趣飙升
summary: According to Cars.com, interest in electric vehicles (EVs) increased by 25% over the last month — likely a result of higher gas prices. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian breaks down the details.
summary_zh: 据 Cars.com 称，上个月对电动汽车 (EV) 的兴趣增加了 25%，这可能是汽油价格上涨的结果。雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 详细分析了这些细节。

title: Are markets at risk of complacency after 'moving on' from Iran war?
title_zh: 伊朗战争“继续前行”后，市场是否面临自满的风险？
summary: The Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) led US stocks in Friday's gains alongside the S&P 500 (^GSPC), while the Dow Jones Industrial Average (^DJI) ended the trading week slightly lower.
summary_zh: 周五，纳斯达克综合指数 (^IXIC) 与标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 一起领涨美国股市，而道琼斯工业平均指数 (^DJI) 在交易周收盘时小幅下跌。

summary_zh: 雅虎财经主播乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 在本期《市场分钟》中追踪了当今最热门的股票和最大的市场故事，包括彭博社的报道称 Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL) 计划向 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 和 Nvidia (NVDA) 的市值回撤至 ...

title: Intel stock hits record high, Hut 8's Google-backed data center
title_zh: 英特尔股价创历史新高 Hut 8 谷歌支持数据中心
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Producer John Hyland tracks Friday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories. The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is on track for its fourth straight week of gains. Intel (INTC) stock is skyrocketing after the company reported earnings, reaching a new all-time high.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级制作人约翰·海兰德追踪周五走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事。标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 有望连续第四周上涨。英特尔（INTC）公布财报后，其股价飙升，创下历史新高。

title: What's next for Tesla
title_zh: 特斯拉的下一步是什么
summary: Tesla (TSLA) beat first quarter earnings and revenue estimates on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 特斯拉（TSLA）周三超出了第一季度盈利和收入预期。

title: Stock buybacks stay hot, while Big Tech beasts like Meta lay off workers en masse
title_zh: 股票回购持续火热，而 Meta 等大型科技巨头大规模裁员
summary: While the HR departments at Big Tech work overtime to craft exit packages and collect laptops from laid-off workers, companies also appear to be working overtime to repurchase stock.
summary_zh: 虽然大型科技公司的人力资源部门加班加点地制作退出方案并从下岗工人那里收集笔记本电脑，但公司似乎也在加班加点地回购股票。
